p.t: Sound Waves: The Symphony of Physics
p.d: Dr Helen Czerski examines the extraordinary messages sound waves carry, and how they help us understand the world around us. Visiting a hidden location buried beneath the hills of Scotland, Helen experiences some of the most extreme acoustics in the world. She discovers how sound has driven the evolution of incredible biological systems and complex relationships between creatures that exploit sound for hunting.

Jack and Victor visit Toronto and enjoy all that Canada has to offer, from hockey to Niagara Falls, leading them to wonder if they should return home.

After rising through the ranks of her male-dominated profession, idealistic FBI agent Kate Macer receives a top assignment. Recruited by mysterious government official Matt Graver, Kate joins a task force for the escalating war against drugs. Led by the intense and shadowy Alejandro, the team travels back-and-forth across the US Mexican border, using one cartel boss to flush out a bigger one.

FBI agent Matt Graver calls on mysterious operative Alejandro Gillick when Mexican drug cartels start to smuggle terrorists across the US border. The war escalates even further when Alejandro kidnaps a top kingpin's daughter to deliberately increase the tensions. When the young girl is seen as collateral damage, the two men will determine her fate as they question everything that they are fighting for.
The police ombudsman investigates the team after a disastrous night shift. Helen uncovers a scandal, while a crisis at home has Grace doubting her career choice.
Mo's side deal goes ahead, risking his relationship with his father. Tommy's firearms exam is brought forward, and Stevie tries to convince Grace to come back to work.
The team work together after the shooting. Stevie clashes with the spooks, Mo learns the truth about his father, and Grace accepts that she might break her promise to Angela.

Matt Tebbutt delivers a tasting menu from favourite Saturday Kitchen chefs. Shivi Ramoutar prepares her green seasoning chicken with coconut rice, peas and a splash of hot pepper sauce. Yotam Ottolenghi dishes up fillets of halibut in a spicy tomato sauce with a tahini dressing and a side of mint and feta-baked rice. Philip Khoury whips up his two-ingredient chocolate mousse served with an abundance of toppings, including chocolate curls, candied pistachios and pistachio praline.

p.t: Lorraine Pascale: How to Be a Better Cook
p.d: Neil Forster is an impatient cook who reaches for the takeaway menu rather than making food from scratch. Lorraine shows him recipes including asparagus and cream cheese puff pastry tarts, a quick way to do roast chicken and an irresistible summer fruit pudding with a neat shortcut.

Nigel cooks up our favourite ready meal, lasagne and tries to match the price of the off-the-shelf version of this popular dish. Adam meanwhile, sets his own challenge to grow durum wheat, used to make pasta, on the Cotswolds farm.

Real-life drama about a family chimps, who are trapped in the lost world of the Kyambura. This deep and ancient forested gorge runs through the African savannah and for years, it has been cut off from the rest of the jungle, leaving the chimps imprisoned. Here, they face a daily life-or-death dilemma; whether to leave the safety of the gorge and venture into the predator-ridden savannah to find food, or face hunger.
It's the grand final for the last three aspiring art dealer pairs. Competing at Frieze Week, only one can win the top prize of £50,000 worth of brilliant British art.
Jill Douglas presents [LIVE] coverage of the UCI Road World Championships women's time trial - being held for the second time in Montreal, Canada.

Paul Martin and the team are in the picturesque village of Saltaire, West Yorkshire. David Barby finds six tasty sandwich makers and Michael Baggott digs out a 400-year-old Laurel gold coin circa 1603-1625. Presenter Paul also visits Temple Newsam, a 17th century house being restored to its former glory by a dedicated and skilled restoration team.
Three soap stars from past road trips, Emmerdale's Hayley Tamaddon, Corrie's Will Mellor and EastEnders star Danny Dyer, go antique-shopping. Who will be the biggest wheeler-dealer?

Two-time winner Alex Noren defends the title he won in 2025 after a dramatic play-off victory last year.

Seven celebrities of differing faiths and beliefs experience an emotional journey on a pilgrimage in North Wales, a route linked by churches dedicated to early Celtic Christian saints.
Simon Reeve journeys through the lost world of Papua New Guinea's tropical rainforest, in search of the tenkile tree kangaroo, one of the rarest animals on Earth.
A child from the Mumbai slums is accused of fraud after victory in India's 'Who Wants to be a Millionaire?'.

Francine kommt sich überflüssig vor, seitdem Stan den Haushalt übernommen hat. Sie will einem Frauenclub beitreten, um ihr Selbstbewusstsein zu stärken. Derweil werden durch Stans neuen besten Freund Loyalitäten auf die Probe gestellt.

Stan und Roger hatten einen harten Tag. Frustriert geraten die beiden aneinander und plötzlich tauschen sie die Körper und müssen einige Zeit im Körper des anderen verbringen. Mit teils fatalen Folgen! Roger wird mit dem Druck in Stans Büro nicht fertig und Stan fühlt sich in der Rolle Rogers schlicht unnütz.

Hayley beschließt, nach Frankreich auszuwandern, was Stan dazu veranlasst, Gott und die Welt in Bewegung zu versetzen, um sie an Ort und Stelle zu halten. Dabei schreckt er auch nicht davor zurück, Hayley zu beichten, dass sie als kleines Kind von der CIA einer Gehirnwäsche unterzogen wurde.

Die Familie fährt ab nach Texas unter dem Vorwand einer Kaninchenshow, obwohl Deweys fettes Kaninchen keine Chance hat. Hal knackt den Jackpot und Lois ist außer sich vor Begeisterung von der Show ihres Helden Boone Vincent.

Die Jungs müssen auf Jamie passen, während Hal Windeln kaufen geht. Doch dann sind da drei Mädels, die mit ihnen ausgehen möchten. Malcolm und Reese merken, dass sie nur von ihnen ausgenutzt werden. Dewey bleibt unterdessen bei Jamie.

Die Familie ist fest entschlossen, dass ihr Thanksgiving-Fest dieses Jahr nicht zur Katastrophe werden soll. Doch wieder geht alles schief: Reese ist nervig, Malcolm betrinkt sich und Francis und Piama sind schlecht gelaunt.
Für eine Schulaufgabe soll Malcolm seinen Bruder heimlich filmen.
Die Nachbarn Henry und Margaret Farnsby schlittern in eine Ehekrise. Auslöser dafür ist Sam.

Ein Missgeschick mit einem undichten Warmwasserbereiter droht die Weihnachtsfeiertage zu ruinieren, während Sam und Jay sich darauf vorbereiten, Jays anspruchsvollen Vater, seine schwer zu beeindruckende Mutter und seine Schwester Bela zu bewirten.
Jay wurde von seinem Körper getrennt. In seinem geisterhaften Zustand kann er zum ersten Mal die Geister sehen - und heimlich seine Eltern belauschen. Pete besucht Jay in Sams Körper.

Cameron reagiert eifersüchtig auf Gloria, da sie die perfekte Ersatzmutter für Lily spielt. Manny versucht zwischen den beiden zu vermitteln und denkt sich eine Geschichte aus, die die Erwachsenen zum Nachdenken bringen soll.

Als Dank für einen Hausverkauf an Freunde von Mitch und Cam laden Phil und Claire zu einem gemeinsamen Drink ein, der in überschwänglicher Schwesterliebe endet. Doch dem nicht genug: Die Folgen sind weitaus dramatischer.

Mitchell ruiniert Jays stolzesten Golfmoment, indem er ihn vor versammelter Mannschaft bloßstellt. Derweil erfährt Phil zufällig etwas Schockierendes über sein kleines Mädchen und Gloria kommt hinter Claires gefährliches Geheimnis.

Camerons Geburtstag steht an, der 29. Februar. Mitchell ist extrem unter Druck, den Tag so perfekt wie möglich zu gestalten. Doch seine Pläne arten aus. Auch bei Phil, Jay und Gloria verläuft der Tag nicht wie gewünscht.

Zwischen Cam und seinem ehemaligen Partner Clown Lewis kommt es zu einem Eklat. Phil kämpft mit allen Mitteln, um einen großen Auftrag an Land zu ziehen. Doch seine Erzfeindin Mitzi Roth funkt dazwischen. Derweil hat Claire ganz andere Sorgen.

Ross applies for a palaeontology grant, but discovers that Dr Hobart - who allocates such funding - used to go out with his girlfriend Charlie. Meanwhile, Mike wants Phoebe to get rid of one of her bizarre paintings, but neither Rachel nor Monica is keen to take it, and Chandler lies to Joey about watching his audition tape.
Monica and Chandler fuss over their apartment as they expect a visit from the adoption worker. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Mike opt for a small wedding and donate the extra money to a children's charity.

Monica reluctantly agrees to cook Thanksgiving dinner, but locks everyone out when they turn up late as Joey and Ross went to a hockey game while Rachel and Phoebe took Emma to a baby beauty contest. Monica also receives some adoption news.

Monica and Chandler are forced to pretend to be a reverend and a doctor when their prospective child's birth mother gets the wrong end of the stick. Meanwhile, Joey's date with Phoebe's friend doesn't go well, and Ross is left with an inappropriate outfit for a date with a sexy salesgirl.
Phoebe and Rachel see Chandler getting into a car with a mystery woman and follow them to a large house in the suburbs. They tell Monica of their fears and are shocked by the truth.

Joey appears as a celebrity contestant on 'The $100,000 Pyramid' with its actual host Donny Osmond, but Joey's dubious IQ costs his partner the prize money. Meanwhile, Monica and Rachel hire an ungainly stripper, Roy - without seeing him first - for Phoebe's bachelorette party. Also, Chandler and Ross attend a college reunion and meet an attractive woman they both promised not to date during school.

It's Phoebe and Mike's big day, but all does not go to plan. Wedding planner Monica is driving the bride to distraction, New York is hit by its worst blizzard for 20 years, and Joey is taking his role standing in for Phoebe's incarcerated father far too seriously. Chandler and Ross are upset that neither of them has a role, until Mike needs to replace one of his groomsmen.

Monica and Chandler discover that their prospective adoptive child's biological father may be a 'shovel killer', Ross and Rachel get dangerously close when they go to visit her sick father, and Phoebe struggles to teach Joey French for an audition.

Rachel makes the mistake of going for a job interview at a restaurant where her current boss is also dining. Phoebe discovers she can change her name to whatever she likes - Princess Consuela Bananahammock seems the logical choice, until Mike proves that two can play her game - and Joey, upset that Chandler and Monica are moving, is comforted by an eight-year-old.

When Rachel makes a startling announcement, Ross secretly schemes to get her former job back for her. Meanwhile, Joey is so flustered by all the upheaval in his friends' lives that Phoebe prevents him from learning about the sudden death of his agent. Monica and Chandler make a stunning discovery after they check out the house for sale next door to their new home.

As Rachel prepares to leave for Paris, the gang throw a farewell party for her. Instead of facing them all together, she takes each of them aside for a private goodbye. One friend is offended when he is excluded. Meanwhile, Monica barks out orders as she packs precisely for her life in the suburbs with Chandler, and they watch closely the pregnant mother of their future adopted child.
The six friends prepare to part ways and set out on the next chapters of their lives, with momentous events and surprises in store.

The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show - now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions - are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turn to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

An introduction to the gang. After Rachel leaves her Mr Potato Head look-alike fiancé Barry at the altar, she moves in with Monica and discovers that independence sucks when you don't have Daddy's credit cards to rely on. Meanwhile, Chandler and Joey encourage Ross to experience the advantages of bachelorhood, and Phoebe supports herself by playing guitar in the subway.

Ross's lesbian ex-wife is pregnant with his child, and he doesn't like her choice of last name for the baby. Elsewhere, Rachel finds out that her ex-fiancé went on what would have been their honeymoon.
Caroline's ex-husband wants custody of Tom.
Charlie schemes to thwart Michael's custody attempt.
Tom sets up blind dates for Charlie and Caroline.
Charlie persuades a reluctant Caroline to let Joanna babysit, but a drama with the kitchen sink gets her into hot water.
Crime capers galore including bus stop buffoonery, a streaker in an airport, and criminally bad driving.
Featuring mobility scooter theft and a policeman takes a ride on the roof of a getaway car!
Criminally funny behaviour, including inept thieves and ludicrously bad disguises!
Featuring crime in shops, crime on the commute, and crime committed by pensioners!
Featuring stolen door mats, people falling from the sky, and stolen items inside someone's clothes!
The show that lifts the lid on the funnier side of crime. Including clumsy thieves, angry bulls, and duelling bus drivers.
The show that lifts the lid on the funnier side of crime. Including mayhem in a fireworks shop, traffic cone theft, and a digger driver's revenge.
We have bad delivery drivers, sleepy security guards, and Santa puts himself on the naughty list.
Features crimes against fashion, crimes against florists, and crimes committed by canines!
Lawless laughs featuring neighbourly disputes, car crime, and OAP outlaws.

As Rachel prepares to leave for Paris, the gang throw a farewell party for her. Instead of facing them all together, she takes each of them aside for a private goodbye. One friend is offended when he is excluded. Meanwhile, Monica barks out orders as she packs precisely for her life in the suburbs with Chandler, and they watch closely the pregnant mother of their future adopted child.
When a young woman goes missing on Valentine's Day, detectives turn to a pollen expert, who pieces together fragments of evidence to find her body.
In 1994, a gang kill a woman who manages a building society and tie up her husband, before robbing the building society of large sums of cash.
A look at the shocking murder of 65-year-old Maureen Cosgrove. She was killed by her daughter's partner in her £800,000 home in London in 2009.
A look at the shocking death of pub landlady Rebecca Thorpe. She was found murdered in a freezer in the quiet Norfolk village of Snettisham in 2010.
Dermot Murnaghan returns to uncover the truth behind the horrific crimes of Peterborough serial killer Joanna Dennehy.
Having a closer look at the most horrific crimes ever committed on British soil, starting with the May 2017 Manchester Arena bombing.
Canadian engineer Ashwin Desai is brutally attacked in a hotel. Detectives investigate a shocking and senseless act of violence.

The true-crime documentary details a complex police investigation launched after a tragic murder occurs inside a busy commercial hotel room. Forensic experts and detectives work tirelessly to gather evidence, trace suspect movements and secure justice.
When 23-year-old Khloemae Loy is found stabbed in a Greenwich hotel room, detectives uncover a tragic tale of abuse, obsession and murder.

Years after beloved actor Gary Coleman's controversial and tragic death, his ex-wife, Shannon Price, agrees to take a polygraph test to confront lingering suspicions and silence the rumours that she was responsible for his death.

When the body of 81-year-old Helen Gale is found in her burned-out car, investigators in Southfield, Michigan wonder who would murder this pillar of the community. It will be eight years before a blown alibi brings them face-to face with her killer.

When model Dawn Koons, 18, heads to California with dreams of stardom, her family back in Yonkers worry she's made a mistake. Within months, her body is found in her bathtub. Police have a suspect but unmasking her killer will take nearly 40 years.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.

23-year-old teacher Irene Garza was a former beauty queen and devout Catholic who vanished the evening before Easter. Residents of her close-knit border town did their best to find her, but her body was found floating in a drainage canal.
Sade Robinson's first date ends in her disappearance, leading police to burned evidence and recovered remains.
Ken and Guillaume increase production in an effort to save the season, and Chris faces mounting stress after multiple breakdowns shut him down.
The teams take on one of the steepest courses in Red Bull Soapbox Race history in Lithuania. The soapboxes cope with the water jump and savage bone-rattler.
Sixty teams take on a very quick course down Windhaven Parkway in Fort Worth.
Five celebrities and their dogs take on the world of competitive dog training, learning new skills, building on their relationships with their pets, and vying to be Wagging Rights champion.

Paul and Bob are fishing for tench, a fish they have not targeted since the first series. They arrive at Rocklands Mere, a secluded hidden gem in the quaint village of Rocklands St Peter, and settle down to fish.

Paul and Bob arrive in the Republic of Ireland, and they're kicking off their all-out Irish fishing trip on the River Finn. It's their first time fishing the rivers of both the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland.

Rob Brydon is back in the host's chair for the seventh series of the comedy panel show. Over the course of each show, celebrity guests reveal amazing stories about themselves, some of which are true and some of which are not. In this episode, Lee and David are joined by Charles Dance OBE, Stephen Mangan, Isy Suttie and Gok Wan.
Lee and David discern fact from fiction and try to figure out who is lying and who is telling the truth with special guests Joan Bakewell, Warwick Davis, Paul Hollywood and Jason Manford.
Team captains Lee and David discern fact from fiction and try to determine who is lying with special guests Matt Dawson, Mel Giedroyc, Dermot O'Leary and Josh Widdicombe.
David Mitchell is joined by Susan Calman and Richard Osman, and Lee Mack is joined by Carol Kirkwood and David O'Doherty.

Beginning in Chile, Simon crosses the Atacama Desert and climbs 15,000 feet into the Andes. In Argentina, he dodges angry South American bees as he hunts for honey with the indigenous Wichi people, and in Brazil he tastes the delights of São Paulo.
Guy Martin travels to a remote island in the Hebrides to live and work on a dairy farm during calving season - after learning the ropes, he milks a herd of cows by himself.
Rhod Gilbert, Sara Pascoe, Harriet Kemsley, Kae Kurd and Vicky Pattison and their dogs take on classic agility training, as they compete for the top spot on the leaderboard.

p.t: Have I Got a Bit More News for You [NEW]
p.d: Alexander Armstrong hosts, with guest panellists comedian Ross Noble and journalist Helen Lewis joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop.

Stephen and Alan have a look at journeys with Cal Wilson, Rob Brydon, and Phill Jupitus. Together, they discover the travel arrangements of a Japanese snail, the procedure for evacuating a ship, and who the naturalist was on the HMS Beagle.
Mike finds a Toyota Land Cruiser with a 4-speed transmission that holds the car below highway speeds. Can the team fix up the SUV before the buyers arrive?
Mike gets nostalgic in a 1985 Merkur XR4Ti, also known as the Ford Sierra. He has found a rare competition shell model and Ant applies some unique European touches.

A young couple sets out to create their dream treehouse retreat in Northern Georgia overlooking the breathtaking Blue Ridge Mountains. Although the build calls for a mile-long, uphill trek, they hope it will go smoothly.

An overworked gymnastics coach begins work on his dream cabin in Utah's Wasatch Mountain Range. Malfunctioning equipment, being far from town, extreme weather and unpredictable wildlife threaten to turn his dream into a nightmare.

A newly blended family is building an eco-friendly straw bale house for their daughter in the mountains of Southwest Colorado; with winter fast approaching, the family races to finish when the build is threatened by torrential rains and cold nights.
Marty faces his most daunting challenge ever in the rescue of a Tennessee homestead. He calls on past homesteaders and friends, Ken and Anita Corsini, a home renovation team to help.
Marty, Matt and Misty Raney use their building, farming and hunting expertise to help people who strive to live off the grid.

Homesteaders too proud to admit failure are surprised when loved ones secretly call for an intervention. Facing a new range of challenges and emotions, the Raneys must race to save not just the homestead, but often the fractured families themselves.

Mark needs a lot of inventory in a hurry, so he buys three cabins on a remote farm; it's a fast-paced triple takedown full of suspense, strategy and plenty of big crashes; the guys discover family stories that give these logs history and meaning.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: When a freak storm unleashes a tornado and a year's worth of rainfall on the city of Valencia, Spain, stunned eyewitnesses capture catastrophic flooding in the urban centre as bridges buckle, cars are swept away, and residents fight for their lives.
A 1933 Roadster has a great paint job, but needs reimagining, and the owner of a 1968 Camaro has a load of upgrades he wants to accomplish.

Dave's clients have owned a car since they got married 25 years ago and want it restored so they can enjoy it for another 25. While the shop isn't really into straight restorations, adding some custom pieces and paint makes them "say yes" to the pro.

Once again, Dave is thrilled with the latest build, while KevDogg is barely lukewarm. Dave has done double-cab VWs, Bugs and Karmann Ghias, but now he is taking on something completely different, and even rarer.
The crew does its best to match the two-tone paint job on the '53 Barn Door Deluxe build. They add a custom trim, a new, more powerful engine, 22 inch windows and a custom interior.

The 1982 Porsche 911 SC: the 'SC' stands for Super Carrera, and is apt for this particular classic. The 911 story started in 1964, when the current owner was born: a local car dealer going by the name of Mike Brewer.

A Corvette disappears into a hole in the ground in the US state of Kentucky. In Australia, a disaster occurs during the construction of a huge bridge in the centre of Melbourne. Heavy construction work shakes the earth in Oklahoma.

A devastating rail disaster outside a small North Dakota town results in cargo erupting in massive explosions; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover an engineering flaw poised for catastrophic failure.
Bruce heads to Ypres looking for items from WWI, finding a German trench mortar. He also goes for a ride in a WWI-era British tank - one of the first tanks ever used in combat.
Bruce finds a picture in his attic from Dunkirk, given to him by a soldier who was there. Bruce and Hus go on a hunt for kit that tells the real story of the evacuation.
A client wants a German half-track armoured personnel carrier converted into a Pioneer variant, used by the German army during the Battle of the Bulge.

Could the World's Greatest Motorcycle Ride be only 37 miles long? Well, it might not be a gruelling adventure, but the Isle of Man is home to the most famous road race in the world; the Isle of Man TT. For presenter Henry Cole, this circuit is motorcycling Mecca, but what has the Isle of Man got to offer away from the racing?
Starting in Auckland in the North Island Henry Cole sets off on two wheels but soon takes to air and sea to see more of the breathtaking scenery New Zealand is justly famed for.
Henry Cole continues to ride his Harley-Davidson through the South Island. His route takes him through primeval forests and lovely west coast towns like Greymouth.

According to legend, the ancient Roman city of Hierapolis hides a secret portal to the underworld beneath its streets; armed with pioneering technology, archaeologists gain rare access to investigate the deadly truth behind these hellish myths.

King Midas and his legendary golden touch is one of the most famous tales in Greek mythology, using advanced archaeological methods, experts travel deep inside mysterious ancient mounds to investigate the truth behind the myth.

Venice was once a fearsome superpower home to secrets, wealth, and treachery; today, scientists use pioneering acoustic imaging technology to discover the city's ancient foundations and reveal how it's still standing.
Blacksmith Nev gets emotional while attempting to fix an antique tree seat. Meanwhile, Alex and Craig team up to work on an extremely long bench.
Drew challenges leather restorer Martin to attach an old cricket bag to a pre-war car. Meanwhile, artist Nick and woodworker Chris work on a carved Buddha.
Upholsterer Craig must be extremely careful when working on a rare French chair. Meanwhile, lighting expert Jolene gets forceful with a 200-year-old lantern.
Henry and Fuzz check out Nir's collection of vehicles, including American air taxis, 1920s Citroën saloons and 1980s Japanese Superbikes.

A deadly design flaw results in a horrifying rush hour bridge collapse that tragically leaves 13 dead in Minneapolis. Using the latest science, experts investigate to reveal what went wrong on one of Minnesota's busiest crossings.

Examines how items such as combination squares, farmed shrimp, ball valves, and string trimmers are made.

How do they make cheddar, the world's most popular cheese? How do they breathe life into Resusci Anne, the plastic woman that teaches CPR?
How does Ford produce the ubiquitous white van, the Transit? Plus, how do they ensure the Driza-Bone coat lives up to its name?

We uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How they make wood-burning stoves that bring warmth to the bleak Norwegian winter. Plus, how to build the synthesiser that changed music forever, and more.
This massive hydroelectric project aims to decrease Rio de Janeiro's frequent blackouts.
Adam joins forces with a NASA engineer to rebuild a rocket-propelled super weapon. Originally built to breach barbed wire in WWII, they aim to fix its fatal flaws.

US astronauts Doug Hurley and Bob Behnken return to Earth in a watery splashdown that caps a milestone NASA and SpaceX mission; live coverage of their return reveals what they discovered and what it takes to come home.

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace-mechanic Sam Lovegrove are in Cornwall, looking for something to buy, restore and sell on for a handsome profit. At a windswept hilltop farm they find cars, tractors and a very rare German scooter.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in the New Forest, looking for things to buy, restore and sell for profit. Today they meet Stumpie, an Americana fanatic whose sheds are full of rare bicycles, classic sportsters and pimped up saloon cars.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in Cornwall, looking for things to buy, restore and sell on for a profit. Today they visit the Queen's armourer, Terry English, and find an amazing collection of vintage British cars, bikes and engines.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in the West Country searching for things to buy, restore and sell for a profit. Today they discover sheds full of classic bikes, vintage cars and extraordinary limousines, including one owned by Eva Perón.

Much excitement as the Cogs head to the Isle of Man TT to launch a new British bike brand. A racing Mini needs brutal surgery after a crash. And Hadrian calls time on Cog Racing so Richard enlists old friends Les and Zog as his stand-in race team.

New staff find themselves in at the deep end restoring a unique 1960s concept car and a rare Lotus. Richard follows his dream of big-time racing and attempts to get his hundred-year-old steam car back on the road threaten to run out of puff.

The Cogs take centre stage with an eclectic display, including the last ever Lotus Europa, at Britain's premier car show - Salon Privé. But glory is short-lived. When Richard returns James May's restored Triumph Stag it doesn't exactly go as planned.
Richard wants to take the business to a whole new level by using the power of social media and embracing his role as Cog brand ambassador, resulting in an intrepid trip to the Middle East.

The Cog re-sprays an Aston Martin Lagonda a shocking pink for Europe's biggest car collector. Richard's daughter Izzy discovers a passion for racing. Richard gets carried away and enters them into a race, prompting a bout of parental nerves.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, the pair are in the Cotswolds where they discover sheds full of stationary engines, obscure agricultural implements and some very surprising collections of memorabilia. Moving on up to Sussex, they go behind the scenes at one of Britain's most famous bike shops, and find in its dark corners and dusty attics, two extraordinary hidden gems.

In this episode, Henry and Sam are uncovering vintage treasures in West Sussex. They go behind the scenes at one of Britain's most famous bike shops, and in its dark corners and dusty attics find two extraordinary hidden gems.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. In this episode, the pair are in Herefordshire where they discover some amazing sheds full of engines, autogyros and weird and wonderful vehicles of all kinds. Eventually, they come away with a British classic before driving on to Gloucestershire. There they find a picturesque farm where deer, goats and pigs, rub shoulders with some vintage agricultural equipment.

Today the boys are driving on to Gloucestershire to uncover some oily treasure. They find a picturesque farm where deer, goats and pigs rub shoulders with vintage agricultural equipment. But can they make a quick return on today's find?
It's the 50th anniversary of one of British motoring's forgotten heroes, the Triumph Dolomite Sprint. So, of course, Mike and Elvis have to get one.
Mike finds a classic 1964 Triumph TR4 in British racing green. It is rust-free, but it has been sitting for 20 years, and Ant has a big refurb job on his hands.
The boys visit Fuzz Townsend's friend Alex and his Rover collection, but they are sidetracked by a slightly troubled British icon, the Morris Minor Splittie.

p.t: Die Pythonjäger - Einsatz in den Everglades
p.d: Da Pythons wechselwarme Tiere sind, wärmen sie sich in den kühlen Wintermonaten tagsüber auf dem von der Sonne aufgeheizten Asphalt auf. Deswegen sind Dusty Crum und sein Team entlang der Highway-Vegetation auf Schlangenjagd.

Kaimaneier sind eine optimale Proteinquelle, aber Steven muss sich im Regenwald leise an das Nest heranschleichen. Denn das Muttertier hält sich möglicherweise ganz in der Nähe auf und könnte plötzlich aus dem Wasser springen.

p.t: Naked Survival - Ausgezogen in die Wildnis
p.d: Laura ist erfahren im Überlebenstraining - Kolumbien, Panama, Philippinen. Doch in Mexikos Dschungel wird sie mit Justin und Malik erneut herausgefordert. Bei 40 Grad, hoher Luftfeuchtigkeit und tödlichen Tieren zählt jeder Schritt im Team.
Das Team hat den speziellen Auftrag erhalten, tief in den Mangroven ein Hausboot zu bergen.
Der aktuelle Job ist zum Albtraum geworden, da das Hausboot in sich zusammengebrochen ist.
Das Team arbeitet an der kniffligen Bergung eines Katamarans, der einige Felsen gestreift hat.

Der tägliche Kampf gegen Schwarzfahrer im Londoner Nahverkehr nimmt Fahrt auf, wenn Kontrolleure und Sonderermittler gegen Betrüger vorgehen. Während Karen und Peter mehrere Personen mit ausgeliehenen Tickets und falschen Ermäßigungen aufs Korn nehmen, werden Buslinien mit besonders vielen Fahrgeldpreller zusammen mit der Polizei ins Visier genommen. Ermittlerin Olga analysiert digitale Fahrdaten und kommt einem notorischen Betrüger auf die Spur, der das Tarifsystem seit Monaten austrickst.

Undercover-Ermittler Dan beobachtet am Bahnhof Kings Cross einen Fall von Ticketbetrug. Ein Passagier täuscht das Bezahlen mit einer ungültigen Karte vor und schleicht sich anschließend hinter Reisenden durch die Schranken.

Tyson Lee übernimmt auf Parker Schnabels Claim mehr Verantwortung. Dabei fallen ihm nicht nur angenehme Aufgaben zu. Am Ende der Woche soll er einen Maschinenführer entlassen. Tony Beets will am Indian River das Tempo steigern.

Parker Schnabel nimmt sich einen Tag frei. Das bedeutet nicht, dass er entspannt auf der Couch liegt - ganz im Gegenteil. Denn es stehen wichtige Entscheidungen bevor. Sein riesiger Claim umfasst 4.000 Hektar, und sein Team arbeitet derzeit an drei verschiedenen Schürfspots. Sind Maschinen und Personal optimal auf die Standorte verteilt? Als Minenboss muss sich Parker einen genauen Überblick über die Erfolgsaussichten und die verfügbaren Ressourcen verschaffen. Wie sieht seine Zukunft aus?

p.t: The Last Woodsmen - Holzfäller am Limit
p.d: Einer von Jared Douglas' Trucks ist wegen eines Schlaglochs ins Schleudern geraten. An der besagten Stelle verliert man leicht die Bodenhaftung - es drohen weitere Unfälle.

p.t: The Last Woodsmen - Holzfäller am Limit
p.d: Jared Douglas und seine Crew bleiben noch drei Tage, um einen letzten Holzkahn zu füllen und die Ernterechte in Höhe von 150.000 Dollar zu bezahlen. Denn im Hochsommer muss das Team aufgrund der hohen Waldbrandgefahr die Arbeit einstellen.

p.t: Die Monster-Jäger - Bestien auf der Spur
p.d: Die Ermittler machen sich im Dunkeln auf die Suche nach der Quelle eines monströsen Gebrülls, das die Berge des Tygart-Tals erschüttert hat. Als sie sich der Kreatur nähern, hören sie ein seltsames Geräusch, das sie zu einem Wahrzeichen führt.

p.t: Die Monster-Jäger - Bestien auf der Spur
p.d: Das Team setzt seine weiteren Ermittlungen im Tygart Valley fort und ist bald auf der Suche nach der Quelle eines mysteriösen rasselnden Kettengeräusches. Dabei kommen sie einigen möglichen Erklärungen für das Geräusch auf die Spur.

p.t: Die Monster-Jäger - Bestien auf der Spur
p.d: Die Ermittler begeben sich ins Niemandsland, um eine Wolfsart zu verfolgen. Die Gruppe wendet einen Trick aus Trappers Tagebuch an, um das Raubtier anzulocken, erkennt aber, dass sie ein Risiko eingeht, als sie auf ein Rudel toter Kojoten stößt.
A 1948 GMC truck that has been stuck in the back of the shop for the last three years has finally been sold. But picking up where Dave left off is a challenge.
Dave and Kevin take the '67 Coronet, '55 Gullwing and '63 Corvette to a car show in Ohio, where they will compete for street rod of the year.
Dave loves anything VW and finds an awesome deal for a rare Transporter pickup. After modifying it, the real dilemma begins: does he keep it or auction it?
A beauty of a car from Kindig's past arrives back in the shop for an engine upgrade. Dave and Kevin head to Detroit to see the latest engine building technology.
Bobby fixes up a '76 Datsun 260Z as a surprise gift for his wife. Andy takes a Jeep Wrangler to Ocean City Jeep Week, but a must-fix problem pops up.
Bobby takes on the build of a lifetime - a hot dog truck. Andy would never approve, so Bobby suggests he attend a car show out of town to get him out of the way.
In an attempt to win work, Richard Hammond and the team decide to enter one of their cars into the UK's most prestigious classic car show contest, known as the 'Concours of Elegance'.
Richard's new state-of-the-art workshop is finally open but with nearly a quarter of a million out of his pocket, the business has got to start paying for itself.

Richard Hammond is presented with a huge opportunity when the MOD arrives with Field Marshall Montgomery's Rolls-Royce, a priceless classic from World War Two. But disagreements in the workshop lead to concerns that they could lose the job.
Richard gets a dressing down by the MOD after the Cogs fail to follow orders restoring a priceless Rolls. An urgent search for new staff is scuppered when Neil has a coughing fit on local radio.
On this super-sized expedition, Forrest scours the crowded streets and tropical jungles of Zanzibar for an extinct leopard many believe was lost to witchcraft.
An aggressive spirit attacks guests at a historic hotel in Juneau, Alaska, and a shape-shifting menace could be responsible for thousands of abductions in the Alaska Triangle.
In 1918, the SS Princess Sophia mysteriously sank near Juneau, Alaska. Experts look for answers to the shipwreck as a ghost hunter tries to contact her victims.
Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot embark on a mission to find out what's happening on the Island of the Dolls, a dangerous place that locals have long avoided.
Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres dive into the legend of Mothman by searching for clues in a long-sealed bunker and a top-secret Air Force base.

Gordon Ramsay travels in the USA, aiming to fix hopeless hotels, mediocre motels and bed & breakfasts with bad standards. In the first programme, Gordon visits Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, to try to rescue the failing Roosevelt Inn. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Roosevelt's owner, John Hough, is more interested in telling jokes and dressing up as Sherlock Holmes than he is in fixing his struggling B&B.
Marge falls victim to amnesia, but as details of her life begin to return, Homer is missing from her memory. Will the lumbering oaf manage to woo her again?
Lisa is arrested when she defies the town's new law on evolution, but a family member unexpectedly saves the day in court.

Homer and Marge play marriage counsellors to help Springfield Isotopes baseball star, Buck Mitchell and his sexy recording-artist wife, Tabitha. Things become complicated, however, when Buck catches Homer giving his wife a massage.

Principal Skinner challenges superintendent Gary Chalmers to take over Bart's education after one of his pranks leads to a school fundraiser debacle. Chalmers takes an unconventional approach to teaching American history which sparks a fascination in President Teddy Roosevelt.

Bart's science fair project, a mechanical baby seal, outshines Lisa's brainy asteroid model and becomes a popular pet among the retirement home patrons. Meanwhile, Homer gets a new and eager assistant named Roz, but when he quickly loses his job to her and discovers her evil past, he and Ned team up to reveal her true dark colours.

A British film-maker comes to Bart's class to make a documentary on the typical American school. Bart's celebrity status is plunged into jeopardy when Nelson receives attention from the film-maker for stealing hood ornaments. Moreover, the film-maker leaves Lisa with feelings of inadequacy, causing her to run out and choose a career in astronomy.

Homer moves out of the house after realising that Marge only married him because she was pregnant with Bart. He ends up sharing a flat with two homosexuals, who introduce him to a world of gay discos and manicures.

After Homer has a hit record with an anti-Ned Flanders Christmas carol, the family decide to get away from it all at a ranch, where Bart and Homer agree to help some Native Americans protesting against a beaver dam, if they agree to open a casino.

Chris is in the hot seat as he plays the game with just one question - join Stephen Mulhern to find out if he can navigate his way through the Banker's mind games or if he will fall into a trap and sell his box for less than it's worth.

Hunika joins Stephen Mulhern for her turn to open the famed red boxes in the hope of leaving the Banker out of pocket - if she is unable to keep the big five in the game to attract some equally big offers, the Banker may just come out victorious.
Emma Willis hosts as will.i.am, Sir Tom Jones, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones are joined by new coach Kelly Rowland. With only eight places available on each team, the coaches must choose carefully.
Stephen Mulhern hosts a celebrity special of the classic game show with Kate Garraway, Pete Wicks and Sir Bradley Wiggins all trying to 'say what they see' in aid of charity.

Spoiled by their upbringing and with no idea of what wildlife is really like, Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Gloria the hippo and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap New York's Central Park Zoo for Madagascar.

p.t: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
p.d: Harry, Hermione and Ron return for a third year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, but the school is under lockdown as notorious murderer Sirius Black has escaped from the jail of Azkaban and apparently has a score to settle with Harry. Hermione has a trick up her sleeve for getting to all her classes on time, which comes in handy in solving the latest mystery for the magical students.
News from the world of entertainment.

p.t: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

Hermione has a trick up her sleeve for getting to all her classes on time, which comes in handy in solving the latest mystery for the magical students.

p.t: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
p.d: Harry is mysteriously selected to compete in the prestigious Triwizard Tournament, a thrilling competition that pits him against more experienced students from Hogwarts and two rival wizarding schools. Meanwhile, supporters of the evil Lord Voldemort send a shockwave of fear throughout the wizard community when their Dark Mark scorches the sky at the Quidditch World Cup, signalling a return to power.
News from the world of entertainment.

p.t: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
p.d: Harry is mysteriously selected to compete in the prestigious Triwizard Tournament, a thrilling competition that pits him against more experienced students from Hogwarts and two rival wizarding schools. Meanwhile, supporters of the evil Lord Voldemort send a shockwave of fear throughout the wizard community when their Dark Mark scorches the sky at the Quidditch World Cup, signalling a return to power.

A cast of carefully selected housemates from all walks of life take up residence in the world's most famous reality TV home for up to six weeks, with cameras capturing their every move and the nation following every twist and turn.

Get closer to the personalities, dynamics and relationships at the heart of the show. Big Brother legend Kate Lawler and podcaster supreme GK Barry host exclusive interviews with evicted Housemates, celebrity fans and special guests.

Between the birth of his first grandchild and the christening celebrations, Pop finds time to entertain frail widow Mrs Meredith. Meanwhile, Charley adjusts to being a businessman and breadwinner, and Primrose falls in love with the local vicar.

There's a mass christening when the vicar discovers that the Larkin children have not been baptised, and a riotous party follows. Meanwhile, Charley gets into trouble when he attempts some wheeling and dealing.

Sybil's growing interest in politics lands her in trouble when Bates lets slip to Robert that she attended a rally with Branson. The saga of the wine thief is brought to a head after Bates makes a shocking revelation and hands in his notice. Edith seems to have found an unexpected admirer when Sir Anthony Strallan calls, and Carson receives a letter informing him of the rumours harming Mary.

Cora discovers she is pregnant, which leaves Mary wondering how to answer Matthew's proposal, since his situation would change completely if the baby turns out to be a boy. Elsewhere, Mary accuses Edith of spreading the story that threatens to ruin her. Meanwhile, O'Brien is angry when she suspects that Cora is going to replace her, so plans an accident for her mistress.

It is now 1916 and the family and servants are preparing the house for a benefits concert in aid of the local hospital. New housemaid Ethel has replaced Gwen, but she soon has everyone's backs up - and O'Brien plays a cruel trick on her. Robert is now Lord Lieutenant of the County but is disappointed by not being at the front.

It is April 1917 and, with most of the men away at the front, Carson is finding it tough maintaining standards in the house. Robert's new valet Henry Lang has just returned from the war, but O'Brien is the only one to notice that he is not well. The suicide of a young officer prompts Isobel to suggest that they convert Downton into a convalescent hospital. Also, Mary hears that Matthew is returning.

It is 1917 and Downton has been turned into a convalescent home for wounded officers. There is a lot to do, and the arrival of the first patients turns the house upside down. Matthew brings General Sir Herbert Strutt to inspect the home, unaware that Branson is planning to make the visit a memorable one. Meanwhile, Violet hopes to find skeletons in Lavinia's closet.

Joe becomes a crucial witness at a murder mystery event when its host suddenly turns up dead - as a fishing trip with Gennaro proves decisive in cracking the case, Elena plots to keep Angelica in Italy.
Joe and Lara suspect murder when a diver drowns on a routine dive, while Angelica suspects that Daniele is dealing in drugs. Joe gets involved in a violent fight at the restaurant.
When the author of a book that sparked a nationwide treasure hunt is found dead, Barnaby and Winter must unravel the cryptic clues to find the killer among a group of dedicated seekers.

In the quiet rural village of Ferne Basset, an elderly resident is found drowned after a violent attack. Meanwhile, a local amateur dramatic production of `Amadeus' reveals a hitherto unseen world of intrigue and passion.
An abandoned lorry with five corpses at the ferry terminal and a man on the run bring Wycliffe's silver wedding anniversary celebrations to an abrupt halt.

Reeling from Philly's murder and knowing that it was intended as a message directly from the killer, Monica attempts to put her family's safety first. But when the killer's identity is discovered and she has the opportunity to save his final victim, Monica races into action. Meanwhile, Nichol attempts to finally get his mother to leave her husband and consider a future without him.
A daily delivery of bespoke Mindfulness content designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

p.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
p.d: Joining Alan at Manor Farm are tennis icon Sue Barker, who talks about her life both on and off the court, and actor Adrian Lukis to discuss his return to his Mr Wickham roots - we also join the Royal Family at the Braemar Games and celebrate the very best in autumnal wines in this edition's Best of British feature.

Gaby Roslin and resident vet Dr Bolu Eso meet a remarkable family who share their home with an extraordinary 37 animals. They get up close with tarantulas and learn how we can help protect wildlife from our own pets. Plus, we see how Chester, a therapy dog, brings comfort and joy to care home residents, meet some gorgeous guinea pigs and discover more about the fascinating behaviour of the animals we love.

p.t: Gary Barlow's Wine Tour: South Africa [NEW]
p.d: Gary and Jason Manford board the Coastal Pacific for an epic railway journey, before wobbling through Marlborough wine country on a tandem bike.

Alan Titchmarsh and the team create a cleverly designed family garden, which is full of fun for pre-school tots without being a primary-coloured plastic eyesore for the grownups who share it. The team give tips on creating a mini-maze, creative sandpits, and how to use plants to give an adventurous exotic flavour to the play areas in your garden.
The latest national and international news.

Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo.

James Bond adventure in which 007 relinquishes his licence to kill, disobeys his orders and goes on a mission of revenge when his best friend's wife is killed by a drug baron. A beautiful CIA pilot flies him to Sanchez's South American headquarters where, disguised as a hit man, Bond is hired by the villainous drug dealer.
The latest headlines from around the world. Followed by a national weather forecast.

When the body of a teenage figure skater is discovered, it sends shockwaves through the town of Wakestead. As DI Crane and DI Radley dig deeper, what starts as a tragic death spirals into a web of lies, institutional cover-ups and moral compromise.
The latest national and international news.

Across seven decades, viewers have witnessed fourteen children transform from primary school pupils into adolescence, adulthood, and now old age. We return to meet the people we first saw as 7-year-olds as they reflect on life at 70.

When the body of a teenage figure skater is discovered, it sends shockwaves through the town of Wakestead. As DI Crane and DI Radley dig deeper, what starts as a tragic death spirals into a web of lies, institutional cover-ups and moral compromise.

p.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
p.d: Joining Alan at Manor Farm are tennis icon Sue Barker, who talks about her life both on and off the court, and actor Adrian Lukis to discuss his return to his Mr Wickham roots - we also join the Royal Family at the Braemar Games and celebrate the very best in autumnal wines in this edition's Best of British feature.

Gaby Roslin and resident vet Dr Bolu Eso meet a remarkable family who share their home with an extraordinary 37 animals. They get up close with tarantulas and learn how we can help protect wildlife from our own pets. Plus, we see how Chester, a therapy dog, brings comfort and joy to care home residents, meet some gorgeous guinea pigs and discover more about the fascinating behaviour of the animals we love.

p.t: Gary Barlow's Wine Tour: South Africa [NEW]
p.d: Gary and Jason Manford board the Coastal Pacific for an epic railway journey, before wobbling through Marlborough wine country on a tandem bike.

Alan Titchmarsh and the team create a cleverly designed family garden, which is full of fun for pre-school tots without being a primary-coloured plastic eyesore for the grownups who share it. The team give tips on creating a mini-maze, creative sandpits, and how to use plants to give an adventurous exotic flavour to the play areas in your garden.
The latest national and international news.

Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo.

James Bond adventure in which 007 relinquishes his licence to kill, disobeys his orders and goes on a mission of revenge when his best friend's wife is killed by a drug baron. A beautiful CIA pilot flies him to Sanchez's South American headquarters where, disguised as a hit man, Bond is hired by the villainous drug dealer.
The latest headlines from around the world. Followed by a national weather forecast.
All the latest news, sport, breaking stories and local weather from across Wales.
As the celebrities continue their voyage into the unknown, risks are rewarded, a mystery box returns and one decision sends shockwaves through the group.

Poirot is drawn into the dark underworld of London's Little Italy when Captain Hastings looks for a new car, but instead finds murder.

Between the birth of his first grandchild and the christening celebrations, Pop finds time to entertain frail widow Mrs Meredith. Meanwhile, Charley adjusts to being a businessman and breadwinner, and Primrose falls in love with the local vicar.

There's a mass christening when the vicar discovers that the Larkin children have not been baptised, and a riotous party follows. Meanwhile, Charley gets into trouble when he attempts some wheeling and dealing.

Sybil's growing interest in politics lands her in trouble when Bates lets slip to Robert that she attended a rally with Branson. The saga of the wine thief is brought to a head after Bates makes a shocking revelation and hands in his notice. Edith seems to have found an unexpected admirer when Sir Anthony Strallan calls, and Carson receives a letter informing him of the rumours harming Mary.

Cora discovers she is pregnant, which leaves Mary wondering how to answer Matthew's proposal, since his situation would change completely if the baby turns out to be a boy. Elsewhere, Mary accuses Edith of spreading the story that threatens to ruin her. Meanwhile, O'Brien is angry when she suspects that Cora is going to replace her, so plans an accident for her mistress.

It is now 1916 and the family and servants are preparing the house for a benefits concert in aid of the local hospital. New housemaid Ethel has replaced Gwen, but she soon has everyone's backs up - and O'Brien plays a cruel trick on her. Robert is now Lord Lieutenant of the County but is disappointed by not being at the front.

It is April 1917 and, with most of the men away at the front, Carson is finding it tough maintaining standards in the house. Robert's new valet Henry Lang has just returned from the war, but O'Brien is the only one to notice that he is not well. The suicide of a young officer prompts Isobel to suggest that they convert Downton into a convalescent hospital. Also, Mary hears that Matthew is returning.

It is 1917 and Downton has been turned into a convalescent home for wounded officers. There is a lot to do, and the arrival of the first patients turns the house upside down. Matthew brings General Sir Herbert Strutt to inspect the home, unaware that Branson is planning to make the visit a memorable one. Meanwhile, Violet hopes to find skeletons in Lavinia's closet.

Joe becomes a crucial witness at a murder mystery event when its host suddenly turns up dead - as a fishing trip with Gennaro proves decisive in cracking the case, Elena plots to keep Angelica in Italy.
Joe and Lara suspect murder when a diver drowns on a routine dive, while Angelica suspects that Daniele is dealing in drugs. Joe gets involved in a violent fight at the restaurant.
When the author of a book that sparked a nationwide treasure hunt is found dead, Barnaby and Winter must unravel the cryptic clues to find the killer among a group of dedicated seekers.

In the quiet rural village of Ferne Basset, an elderly resident is found drowned after a violent attack. Meanwhile, a local amateur dramatic production of `Amadeus' reveals a hitherto unseen world of intrigue and passion.
An abandoned lorry with five corpses at the ferry terminal and a man on the run bring Wycliffe's silver wedding anniversary celebrations to an abrupt halt.

Reeling from Philly's murder and knowing that it was intended as a message directly from the killer, Monica attempts to put her family's safety first. But when the killer's identity is discovered and she has the opportunity to save his final victim, Monica races into action. Meanwhile, Nichol attempts to finally get his mother to leave her husband and consider a future without him.
A daily delivery of bespoke Mindfulness content designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.
Action from across the Football League, including Cardiff v Charlton, Millwall v ⚽ [EPL] West Ham, Birmingham v Middlesbrough and Wrexham v Southampton in the Championship.

Brian Moore introduces football highlights from September 1980 as a Tottenham Hotspur side featuring the talents of Glenn Hoddle, Ossie Ardiles and Ricky Villa entertained Dave Sexton's ⚽ [EPL] Manchester United. There's a south coast derby between Southampton and Brighton at the Dell and ⚽ [EPL] Manchester City against an Arsenal with Pat Jennings in inspired form.
Richard Henwood takes a look back at the glory days of British Wrestling with some classic action from the ITV sports archives.

It's finals day at AFAS [LIVE] in Amsterdam as the remaining eight players battle for a place in the semi-finals of the World Series of Darts Finals. The trophy is getting closer and the pressure is building. Join Gabby Partington, Glen Durrant and Chris Mason for four unmissable quarter-finals.

Ali Hamidi is joined by Bobby Zamora and diver Luc Boerrigter as they return to The Lake of Dreams, aka Grenville. Having failed to land one of the lake's giants in front of the underwater cameras on their previous trip here together, this time they target a huge carp of over 60lbs. Being spring, the carp are constantly on the move around the lake, with the team in hot pursuit. Will the carp run rings around the team, or will the mobile tactics pay off to bank that big one?

Discover how the finest crystal glasses are hand blown, from globs of red-hot molten glass. See how malt vinegar is brewed, thanks to the efforts of billions of bacteria - all carefully nurtured for the job. Go behind the scenes at Aga and see how their iconic country-kitchen stoves are made to last a lifetime. And meet the team at Britain's last remaining tennis ball factory. They turn chunks of raw rubber into custom-made balls to grace tennis courts around the world.

It all comes down to this. Four players remain at AFAS [LIVE] in Amsterdam, but only one will be crowned World Series of Darts Finals champion. Join Gabby Partington, Glen Durrant and Chris Mason for the semi-finals and final, as one player walks away with the title and the £100,000 first prize.

Geoff's looking for a holiday home on the beautiful Caribbean island of Barbados. Tasked with finding the perfect place is property expert Craig Rowe, who has five impressive properties to show him for his budget of £160,000.

Ben Hillman heads to Almería in southern Spain to help Candy and Mark find the perfect holiday home. The couple are looking for a rural retreat to escape to whenever they can. For their budget of £75,000, Ben shows them five fantastic options.
Semi-retired children's nurse Tracey is looking for a holiday home in La Duquesa on Spain's Costa del Sol. Property expert Jasmine Harman suggests five properties for her £140,000 budget.
Lea and her best friend Fiona are on the hunt for a second home in the Murcia region of southern Spain. With Scarlette Douglas on hand, will they find the home of their dreams for £90,000?

From Plymouth, van driver Annie Wroe has given her menu a racy theme with a risqué name for each course. Her starter is 'Something Fishy Going On', her main course is 'Saucy Pork Loins with Veg', and for dessert it's 'Chocolicious with a Twist'.

The second to host in Plymouth is no-nonsense car service manager Suzanne Hyde. She's ready for another confrontational evening, but she's also hoping her 'simple' style of cooking can win over her diners.

It's the third day of the culinary competition from Plymouth and the turn of former sailor Tony Wade to host. Tony considers himself to be the best cook in the group and plans to prove this with a range of complicated and intricate dishes.
The fourth to host in Plymouth is recruitment manger Sarah Joy. Having witnessed night after night of rows, Sarah's hoping to bring a sense of joy to proceedings.

It's the final day in Plymouth and the turn of ex-Navy man Charlie Brunel - who is putting the emphasis on having fun for his night. To get everyone into the party spirit, he is planning on a pirate evening.

At Shelley Guest House in Aberystwyth, husband and wife team Julian and Anna Maria Shelley hope to steal the B&B crown by providing an old school form of entertainment, some Spanish cuisine and a monumental continental breakfast.
The second visit of the competition is to the five-star Ixworth House in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk, where owners John and Sharyn Snell are quietly confident.

Day three of the competition takes place in York, where part-time panto dame Graham Smith runs The Georgian House and Mews and takes his guests back in time with a Nordic test of strength in the afternoon.

A Frenchman in love with an Australian woman attempts to woo immigration. Plus, a strange discovery in the mail room shocks a group of senior officers.
Officers discover a cruel and disturbing item in a Chinese student's bag. Meanwhile, a passenger tries every lie they can think of to get past immigration.
A young passenger's secret past is exposed when he is questioned by immigration. Plus, a woman's harsh reaction to a sniffer dog leads officers to discover something interesting in her underwear.

A Lithuanian tourist rouses the suspicions of immigration when she refuses to divulge her travel plans. Plus, customs officers are left shocked when a passenger rushes for the exit when she's pulled aside for inspection.
Get ready for jaw-dropping crashes, sporting wipeouts, and hilarious moments on public transport all caught on camera.
Buckle up for shocking wipeouts, spectacular crash landings, animal road rage and hilariously embarrassing moments, all caught on camera.

A routine traffic stop uncovers a fugitive hiding in the back seat; police must figure out a way to get a disturbed man from on top a box truck; police must use discretion as a high-speed chase gets close to a school zone.

Police are forced to deploy a taser while pursuing a suspect on foot; police help a man overdosing on the side of the road; police help reunite parents and their toddler at a corn maze; police on patrol must act quickly when they hear shots fired.

Diving into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. The team fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and vet Karina uses a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.
Male kangaroos, also known as bucks, face both risk and reward in their drive to perpetuate their species.
Explores the importance of shared knowledge and group dynamics, and how seemingly anti-social animals benefit from having mates.
For this group of animals, being devoted means putting the lives of their offspring first and going to extreme lengths to ensure their survival.
The most incredible, hilarious and spectacular real-life crashes in the world, all caught on dashcam.

Driving is taken to a whole new level with chaos on motorways, encounters with violent storms, animals on the loose, hell-raising getaway chases, heroic acts of rescue, and some things that are just bizarre.
After the brutal 1994 murder of mother Wendy Speakes in her home in Wakefield, the police use forensic clues to aid their six-year investigation to identify and convict her killer.
As A-Troupe prepares for internationals, Ultra-Elite finds a new studio to call home. Meanwhile, Jude makes a big decision that might change everything.

When Sarah Jane investigates the report of strange lights in the sky near the Tycho Project radio telescope, she discovers a lone surviving Sontaran from the failed conversion of Planet Earth who wants revenge for the deaths of his comrades.
Sontaran Commander Kaagh begins his plan for revenge against the planet and Sarah Jane only has forty-five minutes to stop him. Will she succeed? Elsewhere, Maria makes a tough decision.
When Orbit's plan moves too slowly, Tilda takes charge and teams up with an unlikely ally. But shapeshifting aliens and hidden traps make her mission a lot more complicated.
The latest stories making the headlines both at home and abroad during the past seven days.
Following the residents of the small beach town of Summer Bay, as they deal with relationships, family, love, loss, and growing up.
Lacey confronts Amelia, Zane puts pen to paper, and David is conflicted.

When Deirdre accidentally spills coffee on a regular customer and event planner, Deirdre offers to help him get back on track by lending her rooftop garden design services for his boss's next big event.

Professor Brian Cox explores various extraterrestrial landscapes bursting with fire and ice. There are planets and moons covered in volcanoes, with eruptions so violent that the matter flows into space.

The night might be a time humans avoid, but for most mammals it has always been a world of opportunity. Mammals first emerged during the time of the dinosaurs. To avoid competition with these mighty rivals, they stayed small and only active at night.
Journalist Michael Portillo travels the Spanish region of Andalucia, meeting local people who share their passions. In Granada, he meets a food writer and tries his hand at a potter's wheel.
On the last leg of his Scandinavian journey, Simon uncovers the surprising and sometimes shocking side of Sweden and Denmark, two of the happiest and wealthiest countries on earth.
The need to breed drives all life across Thailand, animals are pushed to their limits as they search for a mate and raise a family.

The core of the Xudum Pride has fled south, but a group of its young females surprises the team in the north; tragedy strikes the cheetah mother, Pobe; Lediba the leopard struggles to provide for her ever-growing cub.

Taut urban tale following a rookie cop's first day of training in an elite LAPD narcotics squad headed by a veteran policeman with an extreme, often morally questionable approach to law enforcement. The shell-shocked greenhorn is left to consider whether these unorthodox methods are an abuse of power or a necessary evil in a city overrun by violent crime.
Jacob's outraged by an injustice, while things come to a head for Dylan and Matty. Siobhan reaches her limit, and it's confession time for Iain.
News and analysis of major stories as Gaeilge.
Congregations from ten Christian churches gather in St Peter's Catholic Church in Bray to mark the start of the week of prayer for Christian Unity.
Reflections on the political week and current affairs, combined with interviews and discussion from journalists, senators and TDs.

A former jewel thief is suspected of returning to a life of crime when a new wave of robberies hits the French Riviera.

Food has always been like a language, telling the story and culture of the country it came from. In this series, Kirsten and Allie meet people who have moved to Ireland, and they get a taste of the food they have brought with them.

Junior Eurovision Éire is back! Hundreds will apply, but only ten will be chosen by our judges. These ten will go on to compete in-studio for the chance to sing for Ireland in this year's Junior Eurovision Song Contest!
Hosted by singer Nell Ní Chróinín, this traditional music series is a celebration of customs and traditions from rural Ireland.
Timothy West and Prunella Scales explore one of Britain's most ancient waterways, the Norfolk Broads, discovering the unique way of life that developed in the Broads over the centuries.
Timothy West and Prunella Scales set off on their third adventure along the French canal system, as they travel down the Marne-Rhine Canal in Alsace and Lorraine, close to the German border.
Robbie sets out to explore the meandering waterways of inner city Birmingham including the Soho Loop and the Engine Arm Canal.
Disaster strikes when the Naughty Lass collides with a low bridge on the Bumble Hole Canal Branch damaging a chimney.
Robbie explores the picturesque Staffordshire and Worcestershire Canal.

In the Taurus Mountains Simon stays with descendants of the original Turks, nomads known as Yoruks, whose lifestyle is under threat from the modern world and an increasingly religious government. They are not the only minority at odds with the authorities in Turkey, Simon sees first-hand the devastating effects of fighting in the country's Kurdish region.
Adventurer and journalist Simon Reeve heads to one of the most spectacular countries in the world, Colombia, to explore the country's precarious future.

The real side of boating with Robbie Cumming. On the last leg of his epic journey across the North of England, Robbie tackles the fast-flowing River Ouse and is forced to make an emergency stop. His destination is Ripon Basin at the outer reaches of our inland waterways.
On the last leg of his journey across England, Robbie crosses an epic aqueduct near Stratford-upon-Avon and gets stuck in a lock in central Birmingham.
The reality of life afloat with Robbie Cumming. A fallen tree and a leaking lock pound hamper Robbie's journey across the Pennines.
The real side of boat life with Robbie Cumming. Robbie runs aground on the Rochdale Canal - will he make it to Manchester?

On the last leg of his 300-mile journey across the north and the Midlands, Robbie Cumming faces issues with ice on the Grand Union Canal. He takes on Foxton's famous lock flight in Leicestershire and completes his journey in the picturesque village Braunston, Northamptonshire, regarded as the spiritual home for narrowboaters.
Life on-board a narrowboat with Robbie Cumming. Robbie tackles a propeller problem and tricky locks on the Trent and Mersey Canal in Derbyshire.
Derek heads to Northumberland to collect a rare 1975 NSU RO 80, Jack draws the short straw again with a Mini Mayfair stuck in a barn, and an Aston Martin DBS husk is auctioned.
Dave heads to the South Coast to pick up a carefully restored Ford Escort. Derek seeks a forerunner of the Range Rover.

p.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
p.d: Joining Alan at Manor Farm are tennis icon Sue Barker, who talks about her life both on and off the court, and actor Adrian Lukis to discuss his return to his Mr Wickham roots - we also join the Royal Family at the Braemar Games and celebrate the very best in autumnal wines in this edition's Best of British feature.

Gaby Roslin and resident vet Dr Bolu Eso meet a remarkable family who share their home with an extraordinary 37 animals. They get up close with tarantulas and learn how we can help protect wildlife from our own pets. Plus, we see how Chester, a therapy dog, brings comfort and joy to care home residents, meet some gorgeous guinea pigs and discover more about the fascinating behaviour of the animals we love.

p.t: Gary Barlow's Wine Tour: South Africa [NEW]
p.d: Gary and Jason Manford board the Coastal Pacific for an epic railway journey, before wobbling through Marlborough wine country on a tandem bike.

Alan Titchmarsh and the team create a cleverly designed family garden, which is full of fun for pre-school tots without being a primary-coloured plastic eyesore for the grownups who share it. The team give tips on creating a mini-maze, creative sandpits, and how to use plants to give an adventurous exotic flavour to the play areas in your garden.
The latest national and international news.

Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo.

James Bond adventure in which 007 relinquishes his licence to kill, disobeys his orders and goes on a mission of revenge when his best friend's wife is killed by a drug baron. A beautiful CIA pilot flies him to Sanchez's South American headquarters where, disguised as a hit man, Bond is hired by the villainous drug dealer.

p.d: Six contestants vie for the chance of answering 15 questions to win a million pounds. Four lifelines - Phone a Friend, 50:50, Ask the Audience and Ask the Host - can help them along the way.
